references.text: Describes how Joshua and the Israelites completely destroyed Jericho and everything in the city, including its king, as directly referenced in Joshua 10:28.
The same pattern of conquest and total destruction is repeated with Libnah, where Joshua struck the city with the edge of the sword and left no survivors.
Lachish was conquered in the same way, with complete destruction of all its inhabitants as part of Joshua's campaign of conquest.
Hebron was also devoted to destruction, where the king and all surrounding cities were completely destroyed without any survivors.
Debir was conquered using the same method, where the king and all the inhabitants were struck down with the edge of the sword.
God's command to devote the Canaanite peoples to destruction and completely wipe them out, as Joshua carried out at Makkedah.
Moses' instruction that no living soul should be spared in the cities that the Lord gives the Israelites as an inheritance.
The Lord's command to Joshua to do to Ai and its king just as he had done to Jericho and its king.
